mechanism: Establish two systems separately with distinct color, material physics, motion cadence and starting zones. Alternate equal proof beats while their spatial distance decreases, align them on one readable axis, permit exactly one convergence event, and end on a third shared result that neither system produced alone.

invariants.rule: Give each system an independent establishing proof.
invariants.purpose: Prevents color alone from carrying identity.
invariants.ablation_failure: Immediate collision makes the systems interchangeable.

invariants.rule: Keep material physics and cadence distinct before convergence.
Reduce one visible spatial gap across matched views.
invariants.ablation_failure: Random angles obscure whether convergence is approaching.

invariants.rule: Allow only one terminal meeting event.

invariants.purpose: Proves both inputs affected the result.
invariants.ablation_failure: A flash followed by reset provides no outcome evidence.
